input.quote: 15.11 Limitation of Liability. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT TO THE CONTRARY, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, RELIANCE OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES OR LOST OR IMPUTED PROFITS OR ROYALTIES OR COST OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES
input.rationale: Section 15.11 is the only limitation-of-liability provision (the arbitration clause at § 15.10.2.4 merely repeats the consequential/punitive damages waiver). It is mutual, but it only excludes indirect/consequential damages and lost profits — there is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement (no "aggregate liability" or cap language in Article 12 indemnities or elsewhere), so each party's direct liability is unlimited. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual cap with carve-outs. We therefore added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' payments and US$1,000,000 with uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data protection, Article 12 indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and preserved outside the cap each party's express payment and funding obligations (Articles 4 and 6 and Section 14.2) so that PB's funding entitlement and the existing Article 6 carve-out are unaffected. Indemnities are not double-flagged here — they are only referenced as sitting outside the cap.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap with uncapped Excluded Claims to § 15.11
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 excludes indirect damages but leaves each party's direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of twelve months' payments and US$1,000,000, consistent with our position on limitation of liability. Indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement and each party's express payment and funding obligations sit outside the cap.

ops.oldText: FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT WILL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY PB TO SFJ UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION US DOLLARS (US$1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS, AND EITHER PARTY'S PAYMENT OR FUNDING OBLIGATIONS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT (INCLUDING ARTICLE 4, ARTICLE 6 AND SECTION 14.2). FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2.
